create_stft_module: create a STFT module to compute short-time Fourier transform with configurable n_fft and hop_length
build_spectral_loss: build a SpectralLoss module to compute loss between two log power-spectrograms using MSE
compute_power_spectrum: compute the power spectrum from a complex spectrogram tensor
generate_hann_window: generate a Hann windowing function of specified length for STFT processing
convert_float_wav: convert a float waveform to 16-bit short format clamped between -1 and 1
